pricing_text: Billing is calculated per second of output video, by resolution and mode. In precise mode, **1080p** costs **$0.084** per second, **2K** costs **$0.15** per second, and **4K** costs **$0.33** per second. Creative mode costs more at each tier: **$0.12**, **$0.21**, and **$0.474** per second respectively. A **10-second** **1080p** clip runs **$0.84** in precise mode or **$1.20** in creative mode. You are charged for the delivered output only.
notes: لكل ثانية من فيديو المخرج في وضع precise. وضع creative: 1080p $0.12، 2K $0.21، 4K $0.474 لكل ثانية. (pricing_parsed في fal-launch.json كان خاطئًا — الصحيح هنا.)
